summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, rights-dependent affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, keep outreach unsent, and continue bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API access exists, but rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; all four legal tasks remain open; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. The compliance baseline is technical only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Both are scaffold sites with analytics unconfigured and unreachable compliance evidence. Public launch and monetization are unsupported. Next evidence action for each: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch.
